title: 2D, 3D & Spherical Shapes
instruction: Choose the correct answer about 2D, 3D, and spherical shapes:
hint: Remember: 2D is flat like paper. 3D is not flat. Spherical means round like a ball. Portable means easy to carry!

items.text: Which word describes things that are not flat?
items.explanation: 3D describes solid objects that are not flat, like a box, a cube, or a ball.

items.text: Which word describes things that are flat like paper?
items.explanation: 2D describes shapes and drawings that are flat like paper, such as a square or a flat paper map.

items.text: Which word describes things that are shaped like a ball (round)?
items.explanation: Spherical means shaped like a round ball, such as a basketball or the Earth.

items.text: Which word means easy to carry?
items.explanation: Portable means easy to carry, like a folded map or a book in your backpack.

items.text: A flat drawing of a square on paper is ___.
items.explanation: Drawings on a sheet of paper are flat, so they are 2D.

items.text: A wooden block or a solid toy box is ___.
items.explanation: Blocks and boxes take up space and are not flat, so they are 3D.

items.text: A globe and a soccer ball are both shaped like a ball, so they are ___.
items.explanation: Things that are round like a ball are called spherical.

items.text: A paper map can easily be folded and taken on a trip because it is ___.
items.explanation: Portable means easy to carry from place to place.

items.text: Why is a paper map called portable?
options: Because it is easy to carry
Because it is round like a ball
items.answer: Because it is easy to carry

items.text: Is a model globe of the Earth 2D or 3D?
items.explanation: A globe is a round 3D object that you can hold and touch all sides of.

items.text: Is a map printed on a flat sheet of paper 2D or 3D?
items.explanation: A paper map is flat like a sheet of paper, so it is 2D.

items.text: True or False: 2D describes things that are flat like paper.
items.explanation: That's right! 2D means flat like paper.

items.text: True or False: 3D describes things that are completely flat.
items.explanation: False! 3D describes things that are not flat.

items.text: True or False: A ball is spherical because it is round.
items.explanation: True! Spherical means shaped like a ball (round).

items.text: True or False: If an object is portable, it is very hard to move.
items.explanation: False! Portable means easy to carry.
